summary: AutoClaw's official blog announces a Halloween login campaign: from October 31, 00:00 to November 8, 23:59 (UTC+8), logging in to AutoClaw claims 40M tokens (4,000 credits), one claim per account. These credits expire on November 8 at 23:59 (UTC+8). The post adds that accounts that had not yet claimed the previous week's reward could claim both for up to 80M tokens (8,000 credits). A separate one-off 100M-token bonus ran only from November 4, 07:00 to November 5, 07:00 (UTC+8) and has ended. The post does not name the model(s) the tokens apply to.
claim_steps: Log in to AutoClaw between October 31, 00:00 and November 8, 23:59 (UTC+8).
Claim the 4,000-credit (40M token) reward for this week's campaign (one claim per account).
Use the credits before November 8 at 23:59 (UTC+8), when they expire.
